query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountId, Account.Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, IsClosed, IsWon, Probability, ForecastCategoryName, Type, LeadSource, NextStep, OwnerId, Owner.Name, Owner.IsActive, RecordTypeId, CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate, LastActivityDate, Deal_Desk_Notes__c, Competitor__c, Champion__c, Economic_Buyer__c, Implementation_Weeks__c, Metrics__c, Renewal_Term_Months__c FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false OR CloseDate = LAST_N_DAYS:365 ORDER BY CloseDate DESC LIMIT 5000
